# C round 224 (PERF-HARNESS-SHARED-LIB-b-i): PASS, with one row B needs to rule on

All 11 checks I own passed on valid measurements, and the Studio stayed safe. Anonymous `/studio-lab` works, and the WAV export is correct at both viewports. Premium auth is not bypassed. One harness row needs B's decision before PERF-2 relies on it (C-R224-01 below). `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. I changed no app source, and HEAD is still `e140ab4` with the tree exactly as A left it.

**What I checked:**
- **Scope:** only the 14 granted files and the 3 new files changed. The frozen files, `package*.json`, `vite.config.ts` and `vitest.config.ts` match HEAD at the start and end of my phase.
- **Budget files:** my own diff script found exactly the planned edits: 2 rows moved to wallclock, the 48 sentence deletions, and 5 note changes. No key was added or reordered.
- **Unit test:** `report.test.ts` is 16/16 green, and every case id from the task exists. My own 11 code mutations: 10 were caught; one was not (C-R224-02).
- **Offline replay:** the round-223 reports give exactly the expected 24 `ratio detail missing` lines and nothing else. The new reports give 0 failures. Two deliberate perturbations (a count and a denominator) were both caught, so the replay can fail.
- **Real Chromium run:** all three perf specs pass, and every compared deterministic median is identical to round 223 (166, 122 and 37 rows). The 1a `commits-per-move` rows now carry `{commits: 91, moves: 121}`.
- **Zoom-slider check:** a real run gives 1 at 1×, 6× and 30 clips. One mutant with a lopsided path and one with a clamped value each gave 0, with the right problem line.
- **Unused-code check, `npm run typecheck`, docs review:** all clean.
- **Studio in the browser (1440×900 and 1280×720):** a fresh anonymous `/studio-lab` showed the demo badge with no stored login. Add → Export WAV produced a 24-bit/48 kHz stereo file of 101.352 s, with 0 frames of drift. `/studio/middle-east` showed "Sign in required" and loaded no audio, and `/api/studio-token` returned 401.

**Findings for B:**
- **C-R224-01 (Medium):** my first full run failed PERF-1b-i on `interact.drag.fade.playing.commits-per-move`, with numerators [60, 59, 60]. The render work was identical; one React commit was merged.
  - That attempt doesn't count as a measurement: my own unit, mutant and typecheck jobs were running during it. The clean re-run passed 3/3, so I reported PASS.
  - Read strictly, the task's §7 would make this a FAIL. I wrote that down in the report, so B decides the row's kind under §8. As it stands, any busy machine can turn this run red falsely.
- **C-R224-02 (Low):** no test checks the MiB limit at exactly 0.2. A mutant that loosened the limit stayed green.
- **A-R224-REVIEW-TENTHS-NAN, confirmed by me:** a MiB row with samples [140.3, NaN, 140.3] passes silently. A's reviewer proposed Medium; I did not judge the severity independently.
- **Notes:**
  - The known first-load error (C-R223-OBS-01) happened again on the first 1440 load; fresh contexts were clean.
  - PERF-1a took 8.0 min in my run, 53% of its 15-min limit. That is above the 50% the next stage (b-ii) watches.

The full suite, build, lint, verify and e2e smoke are left to the root gate. `report.test.ts` is not covered by the gate until root adds the `perf/**/*.test.ts` include.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-224.md
- c-round-224.json
- c-round-224/
